guards.canonical_label: Specific behavioral mechanisms are not AP-required
guards.canonical_statement: Do not treat detailed fixed-action-pattern, migration-navigation, imprinting, learning, mating-system, or plant-response mechanisms as required AP Exam knowledge; they are teacher enrichment under the current CED.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Specific physiological response mechanisms are not AP-required
guards.canonical_statement: Do not require named molecular pathways for organismal environmental responses unless needed by another AP unit.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Specific communication mechanisms are not AP-required
guards.canonical_statement: Do not require detailed mechanisms of pheromone signaling, waggle dance decoding, or other communication systems as AP Exam content.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Selection has no foresight
guards.canonical_statement: Do not encode a behavior as existing because an organism or population “needed” it; behavioral adaptation is explained by inherited variation, development, experience, and differential reproductive success.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Altruism is not population-good teleology
guards.canonical_statement: Do not explain altruism as natural selection sacrificing individuals for the good of the population; use direct and inclusive fitness where relevant.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Imprinting is not universally the first organism seen
guards.canonical_statement: Do not encode “first individual encountered” as the universal mechanism of imprinting.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Energy is not created by organisms
guards.canonical_statement: Do not say photosynthesis or chemosynthesis creates energy; organisms capture and transform energy.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Energy does not cycle
guards.canonical_statement: Do not teach energy as recycled through ecosystems; energy flows through and is dissipated as heat while matter cycles.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Matter conservation is distinct from first-law wording
guards.canonical_statement: Do not collapse conservation of matter into the first law of thermodynamics as though the two statements were identical.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Ten-percent rule is approximate
guards.canonical_statement: Do not require exactly 10% transfer between every pair of trophic levels.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Primary production is not photosynthesis-only
guards.canonical_statement: Do not define all primary production as light-driven; chemosynthetic primary production is included in the current CED.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Cycles are models
guards.canonical_statement: Do not portray biogeochemical-cycle diagrams as closed identical routes in every ecosystem; reservoirs and flux magnitudes vary.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: dN/dt is not per-capita by itself
guards.canonical_statement: Do not label dN/dt as the per-capita rate of increase; it is population change per unit time.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Exponential growth is not constant absolute growth
guards.canonical_statement: Do not say exponential growth adds a constant number per unit time; constant per-capita growth produces increasing absolute increments.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: r/K are not rigid organism types
guards.canonical_statement: Do not encode every species as intrinsically and permanently “r-selected” or “K-selected”; the framework describes extremes along life-history variation.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Carrying capacity is not fixed forever
guards.canonical_statement: Do not treat K as a permanent species constant; it varies with environmental conditions and resource availability.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Logistic model is idealized
guards.canonical_statement: Do not imply real populations must follow a perfect S-shaped logistic curve or remain exactly at K.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Density-independent does not mean no mortality effect
guards.canonical_statement: Do not define a factor as density-independent because it fails to change birth/death rates; its defining feature is that per-capita effect does not depend systematically on density.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Competitive exclusion needs conditions
guards.canonical_statement: Do not claim any two competitors inevitably cause extinction; the inference depends on niche overlap, limiting resources, and ecological conditions.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Niche partitioning is not proof of a particular historical cause
guards.canonical_statement: Do not infer a specific evolutionary history from present-day resource partitioning without evidence.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Species diversity is not all biodiversity
guards.canonical_statement: Do not use species diversity as a complete synonym for biodiversity.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Diversity does not guarantee stability
guards.canonical_statement: Do not encode greater diversity as an absolute guarantee of productivity, invasion resistance, or resilience under every disturbance.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Keystone status is context-dependent
guards.canonical_statement: Do not memorize coral, honey bees, or another taxon as universally keystone across ecosystems.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Introduced does not automatically mean invasive
guards.canonical_statement: Do not label every nonnative species invasive; invasion requires establishment/spread with harmful effects in the relevant context.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Mutation is not directed by need
guards.canonical_statement: Do not say environmental pressure causes the useful mutation that organisms need.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Human-impact rankings are not immutable laws
guards.canonical_statement: Do not encode a universal ranking such as “human activity is always the strongest disturbance” or “habitat loss is always the single greatest threat.”
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Legal-policy details are not permanent biology targets
guards.canonical_statement: Do not encode jurisdiction-dependent claims such as a universal ivory ban as biological memory content.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Mass-extinction label requires qualification
guards.canonical_statement: Do not teach a completed formal mass-extinction threshold as already established solely from the teacher slide; preserve elevated current extinction rates and biodiversity crisis.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Biogeographic gradients are multi-causal
guards.canonical_statement: Do not teach latitudinal diversity or species-area patterns as having one universal cause.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Pathogen effects are not universally greatest in low-diversity/new habitats
guards.canonical_statement: Do not encode the teacher’s broad pathogen-impact statement as a general ecological law.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Final photosynthesis FRQ is cross-unit practice
guards.canonical_statement: Do not duplicate detailed thylakoid/photosynthesis mechanisms as Unit 8 permanent memory solely because they appear in the final practice FRQ.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.
